author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Round head over a round-shouldered body whose forearms fold in so the hands meet at the crotch, with knock-kneed legs, as in the reference. The current drawing was a spider-like stick figure (flat bar arms with a vertical spine crossing into X legs) that did not show the hands-at-crotch or knees-together pose.
omissions: The reference's inner arm lines inside the chest are merged into the folded forearms along the body's lower edge; knees press toward each other 10 apart instead of touching.
